goal: 让 AI 在现有全自动调优的探针设计节点参与，不增加额外 Unity 批跑。

model.credentials: Hermes CLI owns authentication; project code never reads secrets

ai_contract.input: Excel target + verified/phase2/phase1 context + previous receipt WR + deterministic candidate catalog
ai_contract.output: exactly five candidate_id values with evidence_ids and hypotheses

execution.path: auto_loop.phase_analyze -> llm_probe_pipeline -> candidate validation -> Warden -> apply_probes -> Unity -> receipt CSV -> Judge

note: Do not reintroduce Shadow/Canary, Runtime Override, batch advisor, or a second execution chain without new measured business evidence.
